parts.name: nut_plate
parts.desc: Laser-cut 6061 nut plate under the carrier's square. How the bed is lifted (v12.1): the POM anti-backlash nut z_nut (supplied on the motor's screw; StepperOnline drawing A4003: 26 mm square flange, 4-M4 on an 18.5 mm square) rides lead screw leadscrew. Its flange is bolted to the underside of this 9.525 mm plate by two M3 x 20 through-bolts in the flange's two outer holes (washers and thread-locked nuts on the plate's top face); the plate is bolted under the 2020 square's member sq_rear (two M5 from below into T-nuts) and reaches 56.2 mm out to the screw. The nut is fixed: the screw, held only by its motor and free at its top end, bends slightly to follow any misalignment (as on a Voron Trident). Motor, screw, nut and plate go in as one bench unit from above, before the top side rail.
